ablation: low average realized-range correlation with the same trend gate
allocation: fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: Frontier-A through Frontier-I development evidence is already observed. Frontier-J is a new development research look, not a fresh holdout. 2023+ remains excluded from selection.
cost_hypothesis: weekly rebalance and persistent eligibility exits limit unnecessary target changes
failure_mode: range-shock independence is sparse noise or ordinary low-volatility exposure
falsifier: prefer high range-shock co-exceedance instead of decoupling
selection: positive scores, top-K, deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
stop_rule: freeze if falsifier or ablation matches/beats canonical base or if every valid base cell is below the fixed development floor; do not retune after failure
thesis: Positive residual-trend names whose extreme intraday range shocks do not co-occur with peers may carry cleaner directional information than crowded volatility events.
timing: completed daily bars only; no future or live inputs
validation: 2023-2024 remains untouched during development selection; 2025+ diagnostic/live evidence never drives mutation
